# `task_close`

**Task Close.** Close a task with an outcome.  Backs ``aq task close``.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Capability | `task_close` |
| Side effect | `composite` |
| Idempotency | none |
| Retry safe | no |
| Timeout | none |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `task_id` | `string` | yes | — | Task ID |
| `outcome` | `"pass" \| "fail"` | no | — | Overall task outcome |
| `failure_class` | `"transient" \| "hard"` | no | — | Failure classification, when outcome is 'fail' (optional) |
| `work_outcome` | `"shipped" \| "no-op" \| "blocked" \| "abandoned"` | no | — | What actually happened to the work (optional) |
| `commit` | `string` | no | — | Commit SHA (optional) |
| `notes` | `string` | no | — | Closing notes (optional) |
| `changes` | `string` | no | — | What changed while completing the task (optional) |
| `verification` | `string` | no | — | How the completed work was verified (optional) |
| `tests` | `string[]` | no | — | Test commands run while completing the task (optional) |
| `commands` | `string[]` | no | — | Other commands run while completing the task (optional) |
| `deliverable_unmet` | `string[]` | no | — | Explicit exception entries formatted 'deliverable-id: reason'. |
| `summary` | `string` | no | — | Summary of what happened, for the reviewer/dashboard/vault note. Required for tasks whose profile has needs_workspace: true (Dv2 Phase 2 §7 close contract). |
| `abandon_children` | `boolean` | no | `false` | — |
| `skip_open_subtasks` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Flip any still-open subtasks (pending/in_progress) to skipped (note 'skipped at close') instead of refusing the close. |
| `claim_epoch` | `integer` | no | — | Current claim epoch for a pool-session caller (optional — the CLI reads it from .aq/claim.json). |
| `claim_next` | `boolean` | no | — | After closing, immediately claim the next ready task matching this session's profile (pool worker loop, swarm-work-model §10). |
| `wait` | `integer` | no | — | Seconds to long-poll for the next claim when claim_next is set (optional, clamped to swarm.claim_wait_max). |
| `obsolete` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Close the task as obsolete/superseded instead of with an outcome (operator or supervisor only; needs task_id and reason, not outcome). |
| `reason` | `string` | no | — | Why the task is obsolete (required with obsolete). |
